caveats.corpus_is_live: The measured corpus includes the transcript of the session doing the measuring, so it grows during the run. A re-run minutes later over the same 44 transcripts read denominator 1909299 and bash_share 0.58465. This is a snapshot, not a value reproducible to the digit; the gate verdicts are stable.
caveats.read_share_counts_the_Read_tool_only: file_read_share is Read-tool result bytes over context, the direct analogue of the outctl study's bash share. File reads performed through Bash (cat, sed -n, head) are classified as Bash, not as file reads. This host's CLAUDE.md instructs Bash-first file reading while bypass-permissions mode is active, so the two shares here are not comparable to a host that reads through the Read tool: some of the Bash numerator is file reading. Both gate verdicts hold regardless, being far from their thresholds.
